# Static-box parity with source frozen-pose semantics. Dynamic pairs and mesh

physx_box_manifolds 1
limitations: Controlled tests include all 17 original chassis and each positive workshop tire function. Equal Nm/wheel bypasses gearing/AI; individual presets do not certify every combined loadout or complete map.
Fixed solver steps remove frame-rate dependence; repeat captures are still required to measure solver variance.
Raw engine slip/normal-force fields use backend conventions and must not be compared as identical observables. Remaining contact/transient differences are recorded, not hidden by the aggregate score.
